text: The 0 shown in Operating Model!C29 is not a real result: the calculation cannot be completed because it divides by a value that is zero or has not been filled in, and the formula quietly puts 0 in its place. That matters because a missing input now looks exactly like a genuine outcome of zero, so anyone reading this sheet has no signal that something still needs to be supplied. Before the model is used for decisions, confirm whether that divisor is truly zero or simply blank.
